description: Resta del MDS menos el MDT de 1 metro de la Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. Año 2012 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.euskadi.eus. The subtraction of the MDS minus the MDT of 1m results in a raster of the same resolution whose pixel value is the height of the element it represents in that cell. The Reference System is ETRS89 and the cartographic projection UTM30N. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "It remains of the MDS minus the MDT of 1 meter of the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country. Year 2012" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
